items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: Ms. Steve Valenti at the Paddock Lounge, you know, she was renting from this other lady... But she used to rent the place on a yearly basis to Ms. Valenti.

ctx.x: Managers. Because right now this lady, Ms. Matabano, she's running things over there now. When her husband died, Carlos, Carlos Matabano, after he died, then she brought the other people out who was ever into the stuff, you know. So everything seemed to be under her control. So Ms. Steve Valenti at the Paddock Lounge, you know, she was renting from this other lady that on, what's that woman's name? She used to, every Easter she'd be in the Easter Parade.
Not Brazil, Brazil, whatever her name, I can't think of her name.
